data.rationale: The commit fixes an internal parser failure when a JoinAliasVar (created by aliasing a join) is nulled by an outer join and then referenced in a query with aggregation or grouping. This error happened in parseCheckAggregates() because the parser attempted to flatten the whole-row join Var without having a root PlannerInfo, which is impossible for nulled vars that would require PlaceHolderVars. The fix is to leave such Vars unexpanded during parsing. To reach the fix, we need a nested join that is aliased, placed on the nullable side of an outer join, and then referenced as a whole-row Var in a context that triggers parseCheckAggregates (aggregates, GROUP BY, or HAVING).
data.grammar_fragment:
expr<bigint> : <0.2 ?agg_ok> "(" SELECT COUNT "(" "j" ")" FROM @table(t1) LEFT JOIN "(" @table(t2) JOIN @table(t3) ON @join_eq ")" AS "j" ON @join_eq ")" ;
expr<bool> : <0.2 ?agg_ok> EXISTS "(" SELECT "1" FROM @table(t1) LEFT JOIN "(" @table(t2) JOIN @table(t3) ON @join_eq ")" AS "j" ON @join_eq GROUP BY "j" ")" ;
seeds: SELECT a1.c0, count(j) FROM t1 AS a1 LEFT JOIN (t2 AS a2 JOIN t3 AS a3 ON a2.c0 = a3.c0) AS j ON a1.c0 = a2.c0 GROUP BY a1.c0;
SELECT j, count(*) FROM t1 AS a1 LEFT JOIN (t2 AS a2 JOIN t3 AS a3 ON a2.c0 = a3.c0) AS j ON a1.c0 = a2.c0 GROUP BY j;
SELECT 1 FROM t1 AS a1 LEFT JOIN (t2 AS a2 JOIN t3 AS a3 ON a2.c0 = a3.c0) AS j ON a1.c0 = a2.c0 GROUP BY a1.c0 HAVING count(j) > 0;
